content.short: Cash-in and cash-out infrastructure linking stablecoins to local currencies across Africa.
content.description: Kotani Pay connects Web3 users and businesses to mobile money and bank rails in African markets. Businesses use it for stablecoin settlement and liquidity, and wallets and dApps plug into its APIs to offer local on and off-ramps. It supports more than 15 chains and also offers an SMS-based wallet that works without internet access.
content.meta: Kotani Pay connects stablecoins to mobile money and banks across Africa, with ramp APIs and an offline SMS wallet.
